$comment: Bundled palette presets. Values are transcribed from each palette's published definition; see docs/PALETTES.md for provenance and how to add more. Anything not listed here can still be loaded from a .gpl/.hex/.pal/.png file via palette op 'load'.

pico8.name: PICO-8
pico8.author: Lexaloffle
pico8.notes: Fantasy-console fixed palette. Strong, saturated, forgiving — a good default when a user says 'retro' without more detail.

gameboy.name: Game Boy (DMG)
gameboy.author: Nintendo
gameboy.notes: The original green LCD. Four values only — everything is silhouette and value contrast, no colour to hide behind.

gameboy-pocket.name: Game Boy Pocket
gameboy-pocket.author: Nintendo
gameboy-pocket.notes: Neutral grey variant of the DMG ramp.

cga.name: CGA (16-colour)
cga.author: IBM
cga.notes: IBM CGA/EGA text palette. Harsh, high-contrast, unmistakably 1980s PC.

1bit.name: 1-bit
1bit.notes: Pure black and white. Forces dithering for every intermediate value.

grayscale-8.name: Grayscale 8
grayscale-8.notes: Even value ramp. Useful as a working palette while blocking in form, before colour is chosen.
